sources.title: H Company: Holo4 27B + 35B-A3B (Sep 28, day-only)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: H Company released Holo4 series Sep 28, 2026 (day-only): 27B dense + 35B-A3B MoE computer-use/GUI/code/MCP/API agent models + Holotron4 Nano; API + HF weights same day.
claims.context: H Company newsroom + HF blog + models license page, full bodies read (r2).

claims.text: Licenses materially different: 27B = research-only noncommercial; 35B-A3B = Apache-2.0 fully open; 256K context both; API paid tier; weights BF16/FP8/NVFP4/GGUF.

OSWorld 85.2%/$0.08 (27B) vs 80.8%/$0.05 (35B); OSWorld2 61.7%/41.5%/$1.22 vs 30.9%/12.3%/$0.61; AutomationBench 45.4%/$0.05 vs 34.5%/$0.02 (480/600 overlap training split; held-out 49.3%/31.7%); AndroidWorld 85.1%/77.6%; Task Factory 10k tasks.
claims.context: Publisher-run in H harness with footnoted mixes; costs at H API vs Alibaba list.

claims.text: Trajectories open (viewer + HF dataset); SFT 127B tokens + 2 RL LoRA experts + merge; harness memory/shell rebuild with OSWorld trajectory chart.

limitations.text: Publisher-run benchmarks; private-set eval pending; no independent reproduction.
